mission_09: Building a federated learning framework requires careful orchestration of server-client interactions, model serialization, and distributed training coordination. This mission implements a minimal FL framework that captures the essential components of production frameworks like Flower, FedML, and TensorFlow Federated. The server manages the global model, orchestrates training rounds, aggregates client updates, and tracks metrics. Clients receive the global model, train on local data, and return updated weights. The training loop coordinates these interactions, handles failures gracefully, and maintains a history of metrics for monitoring. Understanding this architecture is crucial for deploying FL in production, where you need to handle client dropout, network failures, heterogeneous compute, and secure communication channels.
